pool.text: Bishop Absalon constructed a modest fortress on Slotsholmen where Christiansborg Palace stands today.
The city received a city charter under Bishop Jakob Erlandsen.
The city was successfully invaded during the Second Danish-Hanseatic War.
The University of Copenhagen was founded and is the oldest university in Denmark.
The East India Company was founded to foster international trade.
The Copenhagen Stock Exchange was founded and is now owned by Nasdaq, Inc.
Copenhagen was occupied by German troops along with the rest of the country.
An old ferris wheel opened for operation within the amusement park.
Copenhagen was officially liberated by British troops commanded by Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery.
An innovative urban development project known as the Finger Plan was introduced.
Freetown Christiania was established following the occupation of a barracks.
Kirsten Thorup published a novel with a setting based in Copenhagen.
An international congress hosted an oral literature conference in the city.
The annual Copenhagen Marathon was established.
Barbara Mertz published a novel featuring a narrative set in Copenhagen.
Copenhagen Carnival launched its annual Whitsun Holiday celebrations across the city.
Lois Lowry released a novel set within the urban environment of Copenhagen.
Copenhagen and Malmö have been connected by rail and road by the Øresund Bridge.
A large offshore wind farm was built just off the coast at Middelgrunden.
Noma received the title of Best Restaurant in the World by Restaurant.
